quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: Yesterday, I ____ my phone because the battery was empty.
quests.hint: This is the past tense of the verb meaning 'to give a device power.'
quests.explanation: "Charged" is the past tense of "charge," which means to give a device power.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: When I was young, my parents ____ me stories every night before bed.
quests.hint: This is the past tense of 'tell,' often used together with 'stories.'
quests.explanation: "Told" is the past form of "tell," and we often say someone told stories.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The red shoes were nice, but the blue ones were ____ than the red ones.
quests.hint: This word compares two things and is followed by 'than.'
quests.explanation: We add '-er' to short adjectives like 'nice' to compare two things, as in 'nicer than.'

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: I broke my arm last week, so now I have to wear a ____.
quests.hint: This hard covering protects a broken bone while it heals.
quests.explanation: A cast protects and supports a broken bone while it heals.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: We are ____ to visit my grandparents next weekend.
quests.hint: This word comes before 'to' when talking about a future plan.
quests.explanation: "Going to" is used to talk about a future plan, so "going" fits here.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: She ____ for a big company in the city before she moved abroad.
quests.hint: This is the simple past tense form of the verb 'work.'
quests.explanation: "Worked" is the past tense of "work," matching the completed action in the sentence.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The concert was so loud that we ____ our ears.
quests.hint: Think of the action your hands do to block a loud noise.
quests.explanation: We cover our ears with our hands to block out very loud sounds.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: I was absent yesterday, so I need to ____ up on my notes.
quests.hint: This verb joins with 'up' to mean reaching the same level as others.
quests.explanation: "Catch up" means to reach the same level as classmates after falling behind.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: This soup tastes too plain. Can you pass the ____?
quests.hint: This seasoning is the most common way to add flavor to a dish.
quests.explanation: Salt is a common seasoning added to food to improve its flavor.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: I always ____ the door before I leave the house.
quests.hint: This action keeps your home safe while you are out.
quests.explanation: We lock the door to keep our home safe while we are away.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: My computer is very ____, so it takes a long time to start.
quests.hint: This adjective is the opposite of 'fast.'
quests.explanation: "Slow" describes something that takes a long time, matching a computer that starts slowly.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: My uncle is my father's ____.
quests.hint: An uncle is commonly this type of relative to your father.
quests.explanation: An uncle is usually a father's brother, so "brother" completes the sentence.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: I bought this jacket because it was on ____ for half price.
quests.hint: This word describes when a shop lowers its prices for a short time.
quests.explanation: When items are "on sale," they are being sold at a reduced price.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: You should see a dentist if your ____ hurts.
quests.hint: A dentist takes care of this part of your mouth.
quests.explanation: A dentist treats problems with teeth, so "tooth" fits this sentence.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The train was late, so we had to wait on the ____ for twenty minutes.
quests.hint: This is the area at a train station where passengers wait to board.
quests.explanation: A platform is where passengers wait for a train at a station.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: Please ____ the report carefully before you send it to the manager.
quests.hint: This means to look over something to find mistakes.
quests.explanation: "Check" means to look at something carefully, which matters before sending a report.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The movie was so ____ that everyone in the theater started crying.
quests.hint: This feeling often makes people cry.
quests.explanation: "Sad" describes something that makes people feel unhappy, which caused the crying.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: Remember to bring your ____ to the exam; you will need it for the math questions.
quests.hint: This device helps you solve math problems quickly.
quests.explanation: A calculator helps students solve math problems, which is useful during an exam.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: This cake tastes amazing! Did you ____ it yourself?
quests.hint: This cooking method uses an oven to cook cakes and bread.
quests.explanation: "Bake" means to cook food like cakes in an oven.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: I need to do the ____; all my clothes are dirty.
quests.hint: This household chore involves washing dirty clothes.
quests.explanation: "Laundry" refers to washing clothes, matching "all my clothes are dirty."

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: Please ____ the file before you close the program, or you will lose your work.
quests.hint: This action keeps your work stored on the computer.
quests.explanation: "Save" keeps your work stored so you don't lose it when closing a program.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: My brother just had a baby, so my mother is now a ____.
quests.hint: Think about what we call a mother's mother once she has grandchildren.
quests.explanation: When someone's child has a baby, that person's mother becomes a grandmother.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The store sent me the wrong ____, so I have to exchange it for the right one.
quests.hint: Shops sometimes send red instead of blue, or green instead of yellow, by mistake.
quests.explanation: "Color" fits here because receiving the wrong color means the item must be exchanged.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: Drink plenty of water and get some rest if you want to feel ____ soon.
quests.hint: This word means improved in health, the opposite of 'worse.'
quests.explanation: "Better" describes improved health, which is the goal of resting and drinking water.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: We missed our bus, so we had to wait for the ____ one.
quests.hint: This word describes the one that comes after the one you missed.
quests.explanation: "Next" means the following one, which is the bus that comes after the missed bus.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: I have too many emails, so I need to ____ through them quickly.
quests.hint: This verb joins with 'through' to mean checking many things one by one.
quests.explanation: "Go through" means to check items one by one, which fits reading many emails.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The band played their most popular ____ at the end of the show.
quests.hint: This is a piece of music that a band performs.
quests.explanation: A song is a piece of music performed by a band, matching the context of a show.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: If you don't understand the question, you should ____ your hand and ask.
quests.hint: This is the polite classroom action for getting a teacher's attention.
quests.explanation: Students raise their hand in class to ask a question politely.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The restaurant was full, so we had to make a ____ for next week.
quests.hint: This is what you arrange at a restaurant to guarantee a table in advance.
quests.explanation: A reservation secures a table in advance, which is needed when a restaurant is full.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: I was tired, ____ I went to bed early last night.
quests.hint: This word introduces a result and connects two related actions.
quests.explanation: "So" connects a cause, being tired, with its result, going to bed early.
